summary: Approval-binding safety fix: user approvals now bind to the exact claim receipt_id they approve (approved_claim_receipt_id [+ optional approved_claim_sha256]), never merely to a task_id. Root cause: has_user_approval(task_id, receipts) checked ANY user-kind receipt for a task_id, so a newer claim silently inherited ACCEPTED from an older approval that had never seen it -- discovered live during REG-GOALS reconciliation and confirmed via read-only historical inventory to also affect AUT-TSG-impl. Implementation in scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py: new active_claim_for_task() (claims only -- status_claimed=='done' -- never an approval receipt, which also fixes a latent bug where a same-day-later approval receipt could be mistaken for the newest claim in the per-task status table) and claim_approved_by() (exact approved_claim_receipt_id + task_id match, with sha256 cross-check when present; or a deterministic legacy rule for pre-fix approvals lacking the field: applies only to the claim genuinely active at the approval's own timestamp, never to a later superseding claim). write_approval() now resolves the active claim and always stamps the binding (refuses to write an unbound approval); do_approve() resolves and binds to the current active claim, reports which claim/approval satisfied an already-ACCEPTED check. The '[Awaiting your approval]' banner count in r_now_next() now dedupes by active claim per task (previously could double-count a superseded claim alongside its replacement). No existing receipts were edited, deleted, or bulk-migrated -- the legacy rule is applied at verification/read time only. Historical migration impact (read-only inventory, reported not silently applied): applying the new rule to the real repo's receipts regresses exactly one task, AUT-TSG-impl, from ACCEPTED to VERIFIED-AWAITING-APPROVAL (correctly -- its sole approval predates the claim that superseded the one it actually approved); REG-GOALS and all other single-claim/single-approval gated tasks (AUT-GSC-impl, DASH-S8-design, AUT-VPG-design, ROADMAP-V2, REG-DATASETS, TOOL-REXP, REF-EVID) are unaffected. Tests: scripts/automation/test_approve.py rewritten -- original R1-R4 fixed (fixtures gained receipt_id fields) + new claim-binding suite A-H (exact-claim, old-approval-cannot-approve-new-claim, new-exact-approval, wrong-task, generated-approval-always-binds, claim-hash-mismatch, historical-format compatibility, CLI mechanism) + a synthetic reproduction of the real REG-GOALS incident (Claim A + Approval A = ACCEPTED; Claim B supersedes A with no Approval B = VERIFIED-AWAITING-APPROVAL; Claim B + Approval B = ACCEPTED). All pass (20/20 assertions). scripts/automation/test_verify.py re-run unaffected (4/4 pass). No other module imports update_dashboard.py. D2d-2, experiment/H15 naming, and any real re-approval of AUT-TSG-impl are explicitly out of scope for this task.

commands_run.cmd: python scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py --verify (read-only, real repo) -> AUT-TSG-impl regressed to VERIFIED-AWAITING-APPROVAL as predicted; all other tasks unchanged; integrity CLEAN
